intuition.title: Bulky carboxylate and dynamic amine roles
intuition.text: The authors propose that bulky adamantanecarboxylate provides steric stabilization while more dynamic HDA binding supports a soluble colloid. ACA-only particles are crystalline but polydisperse and poorly soluble; HDA or dodecylamine restores a clear colloid, whereas extra ACA does not. This is a source interpretation, not a measured ligand coverage or unique conformation.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Ligand comparisons and proposed stabilization

intuition.title: Injection temperature versus heating time
intuition.text: Higher injection temperature gives smaller, more uniform particles in the reported HDA/DPE and TDPA/DPE families. The authors discuss nucleation and growth separation. Heating for 1 min, 40 min or 3 h changes nanowire abundance more strongly than the spherical-particle sizes; missing table continuation cells remain explicitly inherited.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Table 1 and temperature/time discussion

intuition.title: Alloy assignment and the remaining alternative
intuition.text: ICP-AES and EDX report an approximately 1:3 Co/Pt ratio across the preparations. XRD and HRTEM support chemically disordered fcc CoPt3. The authors explicitly note that diffraction alone cannot completely exclude phase segregation or a core–shell model, then argue against those alternatives using TEM contrast and composition behavior. No measured atomic coordinates, ordered L12 cell or core–shell interface is asserted.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
